prompt: Prime-time adult animated sitcom characters with simple rounded cartoon bodies, flat colour and black outlines, but every face is painted with startling real skin: pores, stubble, wrinkles, wet tired eyes, real eyelids, far more lifelike than anything around it, no feature exaggerated. Every colour is laid on in thick visible oil brushstrokes. Night, a secret 1930s basement, seen over the shoulders and heads of a packed silent crowd of working people, young and old, men and women, Black, white and South Asian, half in red scarves and half in blue scarves, filling the room in the near foreground: at the far end, backed up against the glowing iron door of a furnace, a tall skinny mayor in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache holds out a tall white tiered cake on a silver tray with both shaking hands, smiling a desperate smile. The printing presses with simple faces painted on their sides stand silent; blank green paper money with no printing lies scattered on the floor. Most of the frame in shadow; the brightest values are the furnace glow behind him and the white cake. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
